description: Important policy and evaluation changes must use one semantic release version and synchronize the authoritative policy, evaluation result, four localized homepages, four localized GitHub READMEs, and two-layer changelog before push or deployment.

changeLevels.patch: Compatible wording, documentation, or bug correction without a new capability.
changeLevels.minor: Backward-compatible public capability or contract addition.
changeLevels.major: Incompatible change to an existing public contract.
